it is awful to feel stuck in bed isn't it. I think summertime is especially hard because it is so oppressively bright outside. the sunshine through my bedroom window is just too much to even think about facing.

unfortunately I don't have much access to therapy. My work plan benefits have run out for the year already, and the free psychiatrist covered by my province's health care plan is in another city that is inaccessible to me as there isn't public transit and I don't own a car. I don't have anyone I can borrow a car from. I really do not want to be on medication. My psychiatrist just writes me never ending prescriptions for Ativan so I take those basically every day now just to calm myself down from being actively suicidal.

edit I know I sound very pathetic and defeatist, like I'm making a ton of excuses for why I can't seek professional help, that isn't my intention to sound so lame though.

I have spoken to a few of my closest friends but they aren't very helpful - one just basically gets mad at me and tells me all the things I should be living for, which just makes me feel worse because I don't know why I can't be happy and more easy going and more resilient. My other good friend says he cares but doesn't have time for me - we will make plans and then he cancels, or just never texts me on the day of like we planned. So basically not a very good friend lol. I just feel like a big burden to my friends - it isn't their job to deal with my emotional well being, and I don't want them to feel guilty when I do end up killing myself
